name: JSymphonic Revival
tagline: A Manager for Sony digital players
blurb: A portable MP3/WMA/OGG/FLAC file manager for Sony players.
description:
A portable MP3/WMA/OGG/FLAC file manager for Sony players. Simply copy it on your usb player and use it wherever you are! It is an alternative to SonicStage. (Was NW-E00x Mp3 File Manager...)

This is a fork of the original JSymphonic to use more modern libraries

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
